title: Resolution.
note: A supercar built from 3.2 million dots: a photograph from a distance, stippling up close, seen through the word itself.
process: [[Flora: Nano Banana Pro]] made the black and white studio photograph of an unbranded supercar at 4K. [[Claude Code]] turned it into 3,273,408 dots in [[Canvas]], one per half pixel, placed by error diffusion with a little noise so they never line up. The top half shows them all; the bottom half redraws the dots around the front wheel eight times larger. The word RESOLUTION, in [[Google Fonts]] Anton with each letter fitted to its own cell, masks both.
